list.query: SELECT DISTINCT target_url FROM scan_findings ORDER BY 1

list.name: risk_level
list.label: Risk level
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT risk_level FROM scan_findings ORDER BY 1

list.name: scan_type
list.label: Scan type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT scan_type FROM scan_findings ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Total" FROM scan_findings WHERE risk_level IN ($risk_level) AND scan_type IN ($scan_type) AND target_url IN ($target_url)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "High (7d)" FROM scan_findings WHERE risk_level = 'High' AND detected_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND target_url IN ($target_url)

SELECT risk_level AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM scan_findings WHERE risk_level IN ($risk_level) AND scan_type IN ($scan_type) AND target_url IN ($target_url) GROUP BY risk_level ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT date_trunc('day', detected_at) AS time, risk_level, COUNT(*) AS count FROM scan_findings WHERE target_url IN ($target_url) AND risk_level IN ($risk_level) AND scan_type IN ($scan_type) GROUP BY 1, risk_level ORDER BY 1

SELECT detected_at AS "Detected At", target_url AS "Target", scan_type AS "Type", risk_level AS "Risk", alert_name AS "Alert", cwe_id AS "CWE", owasp_category AS "OWASP Category", affected_url AS "Affected URL" FROM scan_findings WHERE risk_level IN ($risk_level) AND scan_type IN ($scan_type) AND target_url IN ($target_url) ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 500

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(owasp_category, 'N/A') AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM scan_findings WHERE risk_level IN ($risk_level) AND scan_type IN ($scan_type) AND target_url IN ($target_url) GROUP BY owasp_category ORDER BY value DESC
